title: New Halloweentown Movie in the Works, Original Star Ready to Return
text: New Halloweentown Movie in the Works, Original Star Ready to Return A new chapter of the beloved Disney Halloweentown series is being developed. Kimberly J. Brown, who portrayed the lead character Marnie Piper in the original films, has confirmed her willingness to reprise the role, suggesting her character may now be in a leadership position within the magical town. The update comes 20 years after the last sequel was released. On Thursday, October 22, a new installment of the Halloweentown franchise was announced to be in development, set to air on Disney Channel and stream on Disney+ if greenlit. While plot and cast details are yet to be released, original star Kimberly J. Brown, who played Marnie Piper, expressed enthusiasm for returning to the role 20 years after the last sequel. Brown suggested her character could now be mayor of Halloweentown, advocating for progressive Halloween ideas. The franchise, which debuted in 1998, follows a teen discovering her witch family and has become a cult classic during spooky season.
